newsitem.title: UK: LME copper prices hold firm in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LME copper prices hold firm in evening trade.

text.p: Copper prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) maintained the firmer levels set during Monday in anticipation of a continuation of the nearby supply tightness.
The premium for cash metal over three months held around $250 a tonne as the scramble for July delivery metal to cover commitments to the market continued.

Three months delivery at 1800 GMT was indicated at $2,315/$2,320 a tonne and although trading in this position was rather thin at these levels, it was unlikely to stage much of a move on the downside while the nearby tightness persisted.
Other metals, where changed, tended to drift back from earlier peaks with zinc settling at the $1,500 a tonne level, aluminium at $1,580 and lead at $656 a tonne.
